version: rffi_calibration/registration v1 (2026-10-24), frozen before any calibration score on real data
task: closed-set known-TX cross-receiver re-calibration; m trusted labelled packets per TX on the target RX; inductive query scoring

wisig.note: support and query from different capture dates; positions 0..199 of each date

shen.note: split by original HDF5 row order inside each (RX, TX); row order is not verified time order: dependence limitation disclosed

osu.note: records tagged by fixed raw-sample blocks (roles.json osu.blocks) before windowing

coverage_threshold.rule: count-only; RX without full coverage go to the partial-coverage table, missing classes are never scored as zero

statistics.finite_center: A = K + U primary; A = K ablation

heads.H0: native linear classifier (N/A for new identities)
heads.H1: target mean + pooled diag variance; H1e Euclidean

H2.selection: per budget m, receiver-equal mean accuracy on source_selection RX; reported gate uses leave-one-selection-RX-out cross-fitting

heads.H2fix: alpha = m/(m+2) with pooled diag variance
heads.H2L: exact P2E proto rule (PCA .995 cap 32, pooled full covariance shrink .1, m/(m+2))

H5b.note: frozen-head port of the Simple CNAPS classifier; no FiLM adaptation

temperature.method: 1-D NLL temperature scaling per head and m on source_selection query scores (cross-fitted for the gate); affects NLL/Brier/ECE only

gate.where: source_selection RX of each WiSig fold / Shen group (encoder-held), cross-fitted selection
gate.wisig: H4 - max(H1, H2*, H2L, H3) >= +2.0 pp receiver-equal accuracy at m=1, with 5-shot, worst-RX and n_improved reported
gate.shen: relative reduction of the remaining error of the strongest simple head at m=1 and m=5, worst-RX reported
gate.status: engineering threshold, not a definition of novelty; fixed before any real-data score
gate.if_fail: stop claiming that the between/within decomposition is necessary; keep the simple RF calibration result
